summary: Magic Empire Global Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a non-participatory transfer of 2,638,250 ordinary shares (1,638,250 Class A and 1,000,000 Class B) from two unnamed shareholders to multiple buyers; the company received no proceeds. Concurrently, the board accepted resignations of Chairman/CEO/Director Chan, CEO/Director Chen, and Independent Director Lam for personal reasons. Appointments of Huang as Chairperson/Interim CEO/Director, Feng as Director, and Yang as Independent Director took effect June 11, 2026. A permanent CEO search is underway. No material adverse impact expected. Watch for further management stability updates.
